== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tauntaun Handler (Japanese)|Tauntaun Handler]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/159563453/MoqBuDZ9_Uue_lifs6W9wg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 159563453.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b4338ed4102bdb182ec56db6a42b62b4f3c06cdc6b7a23fe816de0079958146a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
